🧠 How MP4 Works

MP4 is a container, not a codec. It can hold video (H.264/H.265), audio (AAC) and subtitles. The file consists of atoms (boxes) — nested blocks with metadata and media data. If the moov atom is at the beginning, the video can be streamed without full download.
